# Public Service Commission of Wisconsin dockets on generation (2026-11-17)

Dockets with a filing from 2021 on, plus the hand-checked list. A document's apps.psc.wi.gov/pages/viewdoc.htm address is a stable public link and can be cited. Copies of documents read are in scopes/us-wi/work/psc/ and are not committed.

## Sources

- PSC ERF statewide filing lists: case types CE,CA,AE,BS,TE,ES from 2021 (https://apps.psc.wi.gov/ERF/ERFsearch/)
- PSC ERF docket pages: 672 of 672 docket titles and filing tables read (https://apps.psc.wi.gov/ERF/ERFsearch/)
- PSC ERF documents: up to 10 filings read per key docket (https://apps.psc.wi.gov/ERF/ERFview/)
- PSC case pages: 53 pages read (https://psc.wi.gov/Pages/CommissionActions/HighlightedCases.aspx)
